$comment: 语法大厅 G28（V0.9 P3 进阶层）。比喻锚点：双层延音：前奏比主歌更早响起。要点：过去完成时必须有过去参照点（主歌）、had 不随人称变、顺叙不滥用、转述句常用（预告 G40）。暗线：had 连人称都不分——层级越深形态越简，一人报时其余冻结的第三张脸。全部内容原创。
title: 过去完成时
metaphor: 双层延音：前奏比主歌更早响起
ketNote: KET 不考过去完成时。它是初中叙事文和 PET 阅读的常客——先在这儿把「前奏比主歌早」听顺耳，初二课堂上就是复习。学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 两件过去的事分先后：更早的那件压低一层，用 had + 过去分词。
sections.why: 中文讲两件过去的事，靠「已经」「先」「之前」排顺序：「我到家时，爸爸已经做好饭了」——动词照旧不变。英语的一般过去时只有一层：两件事都用过去时，听的人分不清谁先谁后。于是英语造了双层延音：把更早的那层压得更低——had + 过去分词。When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner. 到家是主歌（过去），做饭是前奏（过去的过去）。关键规矩：过去完成时不能单独出场，必须先有一个过去的参照点（主歌），它才有「更早」可言；单独一件过去的事，老老实实用一般过去时。初中叙事文、转述句和 PET 阅读里它到处都是；KET 不考。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团在录音棚回放昨晚的演出。主歌一响，音响师突然按下暂停：「你们听——主歌开始之前，还有一段前奏早就响起来了。」那段比过去更早的音，谱子上要压低一层记：had + 过去分词。团长举例：By the time we got to the station, the train had left.——赶到车站是主歌，火车开走是前奏，开走在先、赶到在后，没赶上这层意思全靠 had 撑着。鼓手小北问：「那按顺序讲故事呢？他进来、脱外套、坐下——三件都要压低吗？」团长摇头：「顺序本身就报了先后，断音接力就够：He came in, took off his coat and sat down. 双层延音只在『后说的事其实先发生』时才请出来。」临走团长补了一句：「had 这层最省心——不管主语是谁，一律 had，连三单都不用操心。」

cards.rule: 双层延音：had + 过去分词
cards.detail: 两件过去的事，更早发生的那件压低一层——「过去的过去」。
cards.example: When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner.（做饭在先）

cards.detail: 过去完成时不能凭空出场——要有一个过去的时刻或动作作参照，才谈得上「更早」。
cards.example: By the time we arrived, the film had started.

cards.detail: by the time / by + 过去时间 / when / before / already / just / never...before，都常提示要压低一层。
cards.example: She had never seen the sea before that day.

cards.detail: 不分人称、不分单复数，一律 had；否定 hadn't——比 have/has 还省心。
cards.example: I had left. / She had left. / They hadn't left.

cards.rule: after / before 顺序已明，had 可加可省
cards.detail: 这两个词本身报了先后，两边都用过去时也对；想强调「早已完成」再压低。
cards.example: After he (had) finished his homework, he went out.

cards.rule: 别滥用：单独一件过去的事不压低
cards.detail: 没有参照点就退回一般过去时——顺叙的一串动作也用断音接力，不必层层 had。
cards.example: I went to bed at ten last night.（✗ had gone）

basic.en: When we got to the cinema, the film had begun.
basic.cn: 我们赶到影院时，电影已经开演了。（开演在先）

basic.en: By the time Mum came back, I had cleaned the room.
basic.cn: 妈妈回来前，我已经把房间打扫好了。

basic.en: The train had left when they reached the station.
basic.cn: 他们赶到车站时，火车已经开走了。

basic.en: He told me he had lost his umbrella.
basic.cn: 他告诉我他把伞弄丢了。（丢在先、说在后）

basic.en: She had finished the report by last Friday.
basic.cn: 到上周五她已经写完了报告。

mid.en: I had never seen such a big ship before that day.
mid.cn: 那天之前，我从没见过那么大的船。

mid.en: By the end of last term, we had learned five hundred words.
mid.cn: 到上学期末，我们已经学了五百个单词。

mid.en: When I woke up, the rain had stopped.
He had already had lunch, so he only ordered tea.
mid.cn: 他已经吃过午饭了，所以只点了杯茶。（第一个 had 报时，第二个 had 是「吃」的分词）

mid.en: The concert had already started when we found our seats.
mid.cn: 我们找到座位时，音乐会已经开始了。

trap.en: He came in, took off his coat and sat down.
trap.note: 顺叙的三个动作，断音接力就够——不用处处压低。

trap.en: When I got to school, I found I had left my book at home.
trap.cn: 到学校我才发现书忘在家里了。
trap.note: 「发现」在过去，「落书」更早——压低一层。

trap.en: After she (had) turned off the lights, she left the studio.
trap.cn: 关了灯之后，她离开了录音棚。
trap.note: after 本身报了先后——had 可加可省。

trap.en: I didn't know the song because I had never heard it before.
trap.cn: 我不认识这首歌，之前从没听过。
trap.note: never...before 挂在 had 上——「到那时为止的空白」。

trap.en: By the time the teacher came in, the students had opened their books.
trap.cn: 老师进来时，学生们已经翻开了书。
trap.note: by the time + 过去时是最典型的压低信号。

trap.en: She said she had visited the factory twice.
trap.cn: 她说她参观过那家工厂两次。
trap.note: said 是主歌；参观在说之前——转述句是双层延音的主场（G40 还会细讲）。

redBlack.bad: When the police arrived, the thief ran away.（想说：小偷早跑了）
redBlack.good: When the police arrived, the thief had run away.
redBlack.why: 两个断音读起来是「警察一到小偷才跑」——先后一乱，追没追上全说反了。

redBlack.bad: By the time we got there, the meeting ended.（想说：早散会了）
redBlack.good: By the time we got there, the meeting had ended.
redBlack.why: 不压低就成了「我们一到会才散」——到底赶上没有，听的人猜不出来。

redBlack.bad: The bus had leaved when I arrived.
redBlack.good: The bus had left when I arrived.
redBlack.why: had 后面要过去分词——leave→left，leaved 是假章。

redBlack.bad: She had went out when I called.
redBlack.good: She had gone out when I called.
redBlack.why: go 的过去分词是 gone——went 是过去式，配不上 had。

redBlack.bad: By the time he was ten, he learned to swim.
redBlack.good: By the time he was ten, he had learned to swim.
redBlack.why: by the time 提示「到那时已完成」——学会游泳要压低一层。

redBlack.bad: I had finished my homework yesterday evening.（单独一件事）
redBlack.good: I finished my homework yesterday evening.
redBlack.why: 没有参照点别凭空压低——单独的过去事就用一般过去时。

redBlack.bad: When I had got home, Dad cooked dinner.（想说：饭已做好）
redBlack.good: When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner.
redBlack.why: 该压低的是更早的那件（做饭），不是后发生的到家——had 放错了人。

redBlack.bad: They had ate all the dumplings before we came.
redBlack.good: They had eaten all the dumplings before we came.

redBlack.bad: He said he has lost his ticket.
redBlack.good: He said he had lost his ticket.
redBlack.why: said 在过去——更早的丢票要退到「过去的过去」（转述退一步，G40 细讲）。

redBlack.bad: By the end of last month, I had wrote three letters.
redBlack.good: By the end of last month, I had written three letters.

redBlack.bad: After he had finished dinner, he went out.（有人说 had 必须省）
redBlack.good: after 从句里 had 加不加都对。
redBlack.why: after 已报先后，双层延音是保险不是义务——不挡意思也不设坑。

redBlack.bad: He had hardly sat down when the phone rang.（觉得句式太文）
redBlack.good: hardly...when 是书面套话；日常说 As soon as he sat down... 也行。
redBlack.why: 文白两可——初中阅读里认识它就行，自己写用简单说法不扣分。

contrast.cn: 我到家时，爸爸已经做好饭了。（「已经」排序，动词不变）
contrast.en: When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner.
contrast.diff: 中文靠「已经／先」这类词排先后；英语把更早的那层直接压进动词 had done。

contrast.cn: 火车已经开走了。（「已经」不挑参照点）
contrast.en: The train had left (when we arrived).
contrast.diff: 英语的 had left 必须挂一个过去参照点；中文的「已经」自由得多。

contrast.cn: 他说他见过这部电影。（转述动词照旧）
contrast.en: He said he had seen the film.
contrast.diff: 中文转述不变形；英语转述整体后退一步——说在过去，见过就压到过去的过去。

contrast.cn: 他进来，脱了外套，坐下。（顺序即先后）
contrast.en: He came in, took off his coat and sat down.
contrast.diff: 顺叙时两种语言想法一致——英语也不必层层压低，断音接力即可。

contrast.cn: 那天之前我从没见过大海。（「之前从没」是副词）
contrast.en: I had never seen the sea before that day.
contrast.diff: 英语把「到那天为止的空白」整个挂在 had 上——空白也要报时。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 两件过去先后分，更早那件 had done；没有主歌别压低，顺叙断音接力行。
steps: 数一数：句子里过去的事有几件？只有一件 → 一般过去时，到此为止。
两件都在过去 → 找先后：更早发生的那件压低成 had + 过去分词。
看信号：by the time / by + 过去时间 / already / never...before 常提示压低。
after / before 已报先后 → had 可加可省。
转述句（said 之后）里更早的事也退到 had done。
had 人人一样不随人称变；过去分词拿不准回 G13 查表。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，讲昨天的事英语用过去时；可要是昨天的事里还藏着一件『更早』的事呢？比如你到家时，我早把饭做好了——『做饭』比『到家』还早，英语把它再压低一层：Dad had cooked dinner. 就像一首歌：主歌是过去，前奏比主歌更早响起。咱们玩『谁在前』：我说两件过去的事，你指出哪件先发生——先发生的那件配 had。比如『我们到车站时，火车已经开走了』，哪个在前？开走在前，所以 the train had left。我不懂英语也能当裁判：你每说一句，我就问『哪件事更早』，你答得上来，had 就不会放错地方；两件事要是按顺序挨着讲，那就都不用压低。」
questions: 「我到家时爸爸已经做好饭了」——哪件事更早？哪个动词配 had？
过去完成时能单独用吗？它为什么需要一个「主歌」当参照？
He said he had seen the film. 为什么用 had seen 而不是 has seen？

sections.echo: 这层 had 依旧守着那条分工规律：had 一个人承担「过去的过去」的全部报时，过去分词照旧冻结——be（G29 会见到）、have（G27）、had（本课），三张脸同一条规矩：一人报时，其余冻结。而 had 比 have 更极端：它连人称都懒得分了，I / she / they 一律 had——层级越深，形态反而越简单。英语的时态大厦越往高处越规整：复杂的意思，全靠简单零件的固定组合搭出来——这就是英语的规律性。

memoryCard.alt: G28 记忆卡：两件过去的事更早的压低成 had+过去分词（前奏比主歌早）；had 不随人称变；信号词 by the time/before/already/never...before/转述句；两个别滥用（单独过去事不压低、顺叙断音接力）；警示 had leaved、had went、had ate、said he has lost。

stages.name: 认一认 · 前奏与主歌

questions.q: 过去完成时的两件套是？
questions.explain: 更早的那层压低——had + 过去分词。

questions.q: 过去完成时表示的时间是？
options: 过去的过去（比主歌更早）
questions.explain: 前奏比主歌更早响起。

questions.q: had 会随人称变化吗？
questions.explain: had 连三单都不分——层级越深形态越简。

questions.q: 过去完成时能单独出场吗？
options: 不能——必须有过去的参照点
questions.explain: 没有主歌，就没有「更早」可言。

questions.q: When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner. 哪件事先发生？
questions.explain: had cooked 压低一层——做饭在先。

questions.q: by the time + 过去时，主句常用？
questions.explain: 「到那时已完成」——最典型的压低信号。

questions.q: leave 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: leave→left→left——had left。

questions.q: 顺叙的一串动作（进来→脱外套→坐下）需要都用 had 吗？
options: 不用——顺序已报先后，断音接力
questions.explain: 双层延音只在「后说的事先发生」时才出场。

questions.q: He said he had seen the film. 看电影发生在？
questions.explain: said 是主歌，had seen 是更早的前奏。

questions.q: 过去完成时的否定形式是？
questions.explain: had not = hadn't，后面分词不动。

questions.q: The train had left when we arrived. 我们赶上火车了吗？
options: 没赶上——火车更早开走了
questions.explain: had left 压低一层——开走在到达之前。

questions.q: 「那天之前从没见过」常用哪个搭配？
options: had never + 过去分词 + before
questions.explain: 到那天为止的空白，挂在 had 上。

questions.q: 单独一件过去的事（昨晚十点睡觉）用？
questions.explain: 没有参照点——老实用断音。

questions.q: fall 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: fall→fell→fallen——had fallen。

questions.q: after 从句里的 had 能省吗？
questions.explain: after/before 自带顺序，had 是保险不是义务。

questions.q: 过去完成时最常出现在什么地方？
options: 讲过去故事的叙事文和转述句
questions.explain: 叙事回头补一笔、转述退一步——它的两个主场。

stages.name: 选一选 · 压低更早的那层

questions.q: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
questions.explain: 开演在到达之前——压低 had begun。

questions.q: By the time Mum came back, I ___ the room.
questions.explain: 打扫在回来之前——had cleaned。

questions.q: The train ___ when they reached the station.
questions.explain: 开走更早——had left。

questions.q: He told me he ___ his umbrella.
questions.explain: told 在过去，丢伞更早——退到 had lost。

questions.q: She ___ the report by last Friday.
questions.explain: by + 过去时间——had finished。

questions.q: I ___ such a big ship before that day.
questions.explain: 「那天之前」的空白——had never seen。

questions.q: By the end of last term, we ___ five hundred words.
questions.explain: 参照点是上学期末（过去）——had learned。

questions.q: When I woke up, the rain ___.
questions.explain: 雨停在醒来之前——had stopped。

questions.q: He ___ lunch, so he only ordered tea.
questions.explain: 点茶在过去，吃午饭更早——had had（第二个 had 是分词）。

questions.q: The concert ___ when we found our seats.
questions.explain: 开始在找到座位之前——压低。

questions.q: When the police arrived, the thief ___ away.
questions.explain: 跑在到达之前——had run（run→ran→run）。

questions.q: I found I ___ my book at home.
questions.explain: 落书在发现之前——had left。

questions.q: She said she ___ the factory twice.
questions.explain: 转述退一步——had visited。

questions.q: They ___ all the mooncakes before we came.
questions.explain: 吃光在我们来之前——had eaten。

questions.q: By 2019, my uncle ___ in three cities.
questions.explain: by + 过去年份——had worked。

questions.q: He went to bed after he ___ the door.
questions.explain: 锁门在先——after 从句里 had locked（省 had 也对，但选项里它最准）。

stages.name: 改一改 · 该压不该压

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（昨晚十点睡觉——单独一件事）
options: I went to bed at ten last night.
I had gone to bed at ten last night.
I have gone to bed at ten last night.
questions.explain: 没有参照点——别凭空压低。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我们到时会议早结束了）
options: The meeting had ended by the time we got there.
The meeting ended by the time we got there.
The meeting has ended by the time we got there.
questions.explain: 结束更早——had ended，否则先后全乱。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（公共汽车早开走了）
options: The bus had left when I arrived.
The bus had leaved when I arrived.
The bus has left when I arrived.
questions.explain: leave→left；主歌在过去，不能用 has。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我打电话之前她已出门）
options: She had gone out when I called.
She had went out when I called.
She has gone out when I called.
questions.explain: had + gone——went 是过去式配不上 had。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（到十岁他已学会游泳）
options: He had learned to swim by the time he was ten.
He learned to swim by the time he was ten already.
He has learned to swim by the time he was ten.
questions.explain: by the time + 过去——压低 had learned。

questions.q: 哪一句压对了地方？（到家时饭已做好）
options: When I got home, Dad had cooked dinner.
When I had got home, Dad cooked dinner.
When I got home, Dad has cooked dinner.
questions.explain: 更早的是做饭——had 要给做饭，不是到家。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我们来之前他们吃光了饺子）
options: They had eaten all the dumplings before we came.
They had ate all the dumplings before we came.
They have eaten all the dumplings before we came.
questions.explain: had + eaten——第三形态。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（他说他丢了票）
options: He said he had lost his ticket.
He said he has lost his ticket.
He said he had lose his ticket.
questions.explain: said 在过去——转述退一步 had lost。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（到上月底我已写了三封信）
options: By the end of last month, I had written three letters.
By the end of last month, I had wrote three letters.
By the end of last month, I have written three letters.
questions.explain: had + written——wrote 是过去式。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（顺叙：进来、脱外套、坐下）
options: He came in, took off his coat and sat down.
He had come in, had taken off his coat and had sat down.
He came in, had taken off his coat and sat down.
questions.explain: 顺叙断音接力——层层压低反而画蛇添足。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（那天之前从没坐过飞机）
options: I had never taken a plane before that day.
I have never taken a plane before that day.
I had never took a plane before that day.
questions.explain: 参照点是那天（过去）——had never taken。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我醒来时雨已停）
options: The rain had stopped when I woke up.
The rain has stopped when I woke up.
The rain had stop when I woke up.
questions.explain: 雨停更早——had stopped，分词 -ed 不能丢。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（吃完晚饭后他出门了——had 省略版）
options: After he finished dinner, he went out.
After he has finished dinner, he went out.
After he will finish dinner, he went out.
questions.explain: after 已报先后——两个过去时接力即可（加 had 也对）。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（警察到时小偷早跑了）
options: The thief had run away when the police arrived.
The thief had ran away when the police arrived.
The thief has run away when the police arrived.
questions.explain: run→ran→run——had run。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（她告诉我她已喂过猫）
options: She told me she had fed the cat.
She told me she has fed the cat.
She told me she had feed the cat.
questions.explain: 转述退一步——had fed（feed→fed）。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（发现钱包忘家里了）
options: I found that I had left my wallet at home.
I found that I have left my wallet at home.
I found that I had leave my wallet at home.
questions.explain: 落钱包在发现之前——had left。

questions.q: When I ___ to the station, the train ___.
questions.explain: 到站是主歌 got；开走更早 had left。

questions.q: He ___ me that he ___ the film twice.
questions.explain: told 是主歌；看过在先——had seen。

questions.q: By the time the bell ___, the students ___ their books.
questions.explain: 铃响是参照；翻书在先——had opened。

questions.q: She ___ sad because she ___ the singing contest.
questions.explain: 难过在过去；输比赛更早——had lost。

questions.q: I ___ the door and then remembered I ___ my keys inside.
questions.explain: 关门是主歌；钥匙落在里面更早——had left。

questions.q: After he ___ his homework, he ___ out to play basketball.
questions.explain: 写作业在先（after 从句压低）；出门是主歌 went。

questions.q: The party ___ by the time we ___.
questions.explain: 开始更早 had begun；到达是主歌 arrived。

questions.q: I didn't laugh at the joke because I ___ it many times before.
questions.explain: 没笑在过去；听过更早——had heard。

questions.q: When we ___ the top of the hill, the sun ___.
questions.explain: 登顶是主歌；日出更早——had risen（rise→rose→risen）。

questions.q: He ___ hungry because he ___ nothing all day.
questions.explain: 饿是主歌；一整天没吃更早——had eaten nothing。

questions.q: By last summer, the band ___ together for six years.
questions.explain: 参照点在过去（去年夏天）——把 G27 的延音再往下压一层。

questions.q: She ___ me the book that she ___ in Beijing.
questions.explain: 给我看是主歌；买书更早——had bought。

questions.q: The ground was wet — it ___ the night before.
questions.explain: 地湿在过去；下雨在前一晚——had rained。

questions.q: The teacher asked who ___ the window.
questions.explain: 问话在过去；打破在问之前——had broken。

questions.q: ___ you ___ your ticket before the film started?
questions.explain: 参照点是开场（过去）——之前买票：Had you bought...?

questions.q: 大考：When Grandma ___ back, she found we ___ dinner and ___ the dishes.
questions.explain: 回来是主歌 came；做饭洗碗都更早——两处都压低。

detective.sentence: When I got to the airport, the plane had leaved.
detective.fixed: When I got to the airport, the plane had left.
detective.clue: had 后面要过去分词——leave→left，leaved 是假章。

detective.sentence: He said he has finished the letter the day before.
detective.fixed: He said he had finished the letter the day before.
detective.clue: said 在过去——更早的事要退到「过去的过去」，用 had。

detective.sentence: By the time we arrived, the show already started.
detective.fixed: By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
detective.clue: by the time + 过去参照——更早完成要压低成 had started。

detective.sentence: I had bought a new schoolbag yesterday.
detective.fixed: I bought a new schoolbag yesterday.
detective.clue: 单独一件过去的事没有参照点——别凭空压低。

detective.sentence: When she had opened the box, she smiled.
detective.fixed: When she opened the box, she smiled.
detective.clue: 打开和笑是紧挨着的顺叙——断音就够，had 放这儿画蛇添足。

detective.sentence: They had ate up the cake before Mum came back.
detective.fixed: They had eaten up the cake before Mum came back.

detective.sentence: She told me she had saw the sea for the first time.
detective.fixed: She told me she had seen the sea for the first time.
detective.clue: see→saw→seen——saw 是过去式，had 后面要 seen。
